description: An explore-context profile is always an agent call with no diff, whatever the manifest mode.

expected.prompt:
依赖锐评: review the project dependencies for risk — this is NOT a diff review.

Explore the repository yourself; there is no diff payload. Read the repository's own principles first (its CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md and .claude/rules/) and judge the code against them. Be BLUNT. Praise nothing that does not deserve it.

Scope: Known CVEs / security advisories in pinned versions; Outdated major versions and unmaintained packages; License issues / incompatibilities; Unused or duplicate dependencies

Respond with ONLY a JSON object { "findings": [...] }; an empty array means you found nothing. Each finding is one object conforming to this JSON Schema:
{"$schema":"https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema","title":"sharp-review reviewer finding","type":"object","required":["severity","summary","category"],"properties":{"severity":{"type":"string","enum":["HIGH","MEDIUM","LOW","INFO"]},"file":{"type":"string"},"summary":{"type":"string"},"category":{"type":"string","enum":["Bug","Feature","Performance"]},"suggestion":{"type":"string"},"detail":{"type":"string"}}}
